title: Bullpen price snapshot response
description: The shape returned by GET /api/price/[symbol] in apps/web. Always Bullpen's own shape, never a raw pass-through of an upstream provider's payload -- see ADR-0005.

changePercent.description: Signed 24h percent change, passed through from CoinGecko's real usd_24h_change -- never invented, so PriceCell's change row always reflects a real upstream figure.

time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the upstream price tick (CoinGecko's last_updated_at, converted).

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when Bullpen's route produced this response.
